'''Primitive Devourers''', known internally as '''Lum''', is a type of [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns in groups of 1 to 2 in water, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 15.

== ''Behavior'' ==
'''Note: Part of Primitive Devourers' Abilities are still not in-game. See the [[Primitive Devourer#Trivia|Original Suggestion]].'''

Primitive Devourers are Aquatic Melee Combatants. 

*Their Melee attack is performed through contact damage.
*Primitive Devourers have a chance to block incoming damage, nullifiyng it.
*Primitive Devourer can break blocks that have their Hardness Value up to 1, with a 100 ticks cooldown and 2 Block range. Being an aquatic mob, the broken area is replaced with water source blocks as opposed to air blocks.
*On death Primitive Devourers have a chance to explode, releasing Primitive Remains and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and COTH.{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherPriDevourer.png}}<ref>This currently does not change anything, as Primitive Devourers cannot break blocks.</ref>

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Primitive Devourers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Primitive Devourers, being an aquatic Parasite, are unable to attack or breathe while outside of the water; with the Devourer being in the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] tier it is able to [[Adaptation System|adapt]] to asphyxiation damage.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Devourers are the first Aquatic Parasite ever added into the Mod, in the 1.9.2 Update.
*This Mob was [[:Category:Community Proposals|proposed]] by user '''oof'''.  Original Suggestion: https://trello.com/c/eq8fhxyy/155-devourer
*Devourers are also known as '''Lum''' in the Mod Files.
